name: The Battle of Alterac
label: Quest
description: The Battle of Alterac: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Explorers' League believes there are artifacts in Alterac Valley, but the Frostwolf orcs won't let us explore. We can't allow the Horde to stop our scholarly pursuits! Defeat the Frostwolf general, Drek'Thar. With him dead, the orcs will lose their edge.
Drek'Thar is in Frostwolf Keep, in the south of Alterac Valley. Vanquish him, and then return to me.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Go, friend. Go to Alterac Valley and defeat the orc general!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Well done, friend! With the Horde's nose bloodied after the death of their general, we'll have the breathing room we need to explore!
